posts.community: Greaves Cotton - Is this up to investors?
posts.text: For rerating, GEML reaching break-even in the 4–6 quarter is critical as suggested by management The stock’s risk-reward is therefore most favorable for those who underwrite GEML’s path to profitability or its demerger ; it is expensive on near-term FY27 earnings alone.
